item.title: Naval drones hit Baltic port facility, officials report
item.description: Reuters - Naval drones hit a Baltic port facility, officials reported. Syndicated copy of the same original report.

item.title: Unconfirmed reports of Gulf shipping seizure by armed group
item.description: Unconfirmed reports said an armed group seized a commercial vessel in the Gulf. No official confirmation.

item.title: East African coastal flooding kills 40, local media report
item.description: Local media reported that 40 people died in coastal flooding in East Africa.
